title: Normal
description: One normal attack (C8) in data/moves/<id>.json: a single button, optionally restricted to some directions, with one level of frame data written from its matched clip (F1, F2). Normals have no levels, card or EX; the move system picks the normal whose button and direction match the parsed command, identically for Kata and Kihon (K3).

source.description: Whose kit the normal belongs to ('ryo' for C8).

button.description: The attack button (K1, K2): light/medium/heavy punch and kick.

buttons.description: E19: air normals only. Every button that performs this normal (e.g. LP/MP/HP for the air punch), so no press mid-jump does nothing. Use instead of 'button'; the heaviest listed sets hit strength.

directions.description: Numpad directions relative to facing on the press (6 = toward the opponent, 2 = down). Omitted = any direction. A normal that lists the direction wins over one that does not, so a crouching variant can be added later without touching the standing one.

air.description: E11 (YOK-55): a jump-in normal. true = it comes out only while airborne (one per jump) and ends on landing (E19); false or omitted = a ground normal, never used in the air. Air normals are not overheads (E6): standing and crouching guard both block them.

landing_recovery.description: Air normals only: frames the fighter can't act after touching down mid-move (the move ends on landing). Omitted = the engine default of 3 (E19). The fighter can't block and can be thrown during these frames, and nothing cancels them.
